answer: Each agent binds its identity to a continuous sonnet of LBL ping phases, so a duplicate node cannot fake a second thread of thermocline-corrected ranges without replaying the same ledgered ledge of arrival times. Peers cross-correlate these phase histories via SAS beamforming and reject any identity whose Doppler dead-reckoning residuals diverge beyond. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
